## Cell lines and media

### MC38-gp33-41

- Grows in adhesion
- Mouse colorectal cancer cell line
- Split every 3–4 days
- Split 1/7

Medium:

- DMEM low glucose without L-Glu
- P/S/G (Pen/Strep + L-Glu) 1%
- FBS 10%
- Hepes 1%
- Sodium Pyruvate 1%
- Nonessential amino acids (NEAA) 1%

### B16-gp33-41

- Grows in adhesion
- Mouse melanoma cell line
- Split every 3–4 days
- Split 1/7

Medium:

- DMEM low glucose without L-Glu
- P/S/G (Pen/Strep + L-Glu) 1%
- FBS 10%
- Geneticin 50 mg/mL: final 0.4 mg/mL
  - Note: this is a selection marker to maintain gp33-41 expression
- Hepes 1%
- Sodium Pyruvate 1%
- Nonessential amino acids (NEAA) 1%

### B16-hCD19

- Grows in adhesion
- Mouse melanoma cell line
- Split every 3–4 days
- Split 1/7

Medium:

- DMEM low glucose without L-Glu
- P/S/G (Pen/Strep + L-Glu) 1%
- FBS 10%
- Hepes 1%
- Sodium Pyruvate 1%
- Nonessential amino acids (NEAA) 1%

### PlatE

- Grows in adhesion
- For retrovirus production
- pCL-Eco not necessary
- Split twice a week when they reach confluence

Medium:

- DMEM with L-Glu
- FBS 10%
- Hepes 1%
- BME 0.1%
- Blasticidin 1:1,000
- Puromycin 1:10,000

### T cell media (TCM)

Medium:

- RPMI without L-Glu
- FBS 10%
- Hepes 1%
- BME 0.1%
- PSG 1%
- NaPyr 1%
- NEAA 1%

### UPK10 cell line

Medium:

- RPMI without L-Glu
- FBS 10%
- Hepes 1%
- BME 0.1%
- PSG 1%
- NaPyr 1%

## Mouse injection guidance

### MC38-gp33-41

- 0.5 M/mouse (s.c.)
- 100 µL volume
- s.c. with gray needle
- 1 M/mouse (orthotopic)
- 10 µL volume
- insulin 0.5 mL syringe
- Start treatments at day 10 with 1 M P14 cells (s.c.)
- Start treatments at tumor onset with 1 M P14 cells (orthotopic)

### B16-gp33-41

- 0.5 M/mouse
- 100 µL volume
- s.c. with gray needle
- Start treatments at day 5 with 3–5 M T cells

### B16-hCD19

- 0.5 M/mouse
- 100 µL volume
- s.c. with gray needle
- Start treatments at day 5 with 3–5 M T cells

### UPK10 cell line

- 2 M/mouse (orthotopic)
- 100 µL volume
- i.p. with gray needle
- 12 M/mouse (s.c.)
- 200 µL volume
- s.c. with gray needle
- Start treatments at day 7 (orthotopic) with 1 M P14 cells
- Start treatments at day 9 (s.c.) with 2.5 M P14 cells
